description: Find kernelCAD tools that are not in the advertised list. Returns matching tool definitions (name, title, description, inputSchema); run one with call_tool({ name, arguments }). Example queries: "assembly mate", "nurbs surface", "stress analysis", "find a bearing part". Tools available this way: review_paint_peek_latest, get_latest_render, mesh_summary, report_need, netlist_export, netlist_query, erc_run, search_assets, get_asset, get_asset_pack, diff_scripts, why_did_this_fail, set_param, add_feature, add_surface, add_curve, add_path_segment, trace_from_image, add_variable_sweep, add_text, project_curve, add_pattern_feature, remove_feature, query, lookup_diagnostics, find_part, fetch_part, solve_sketch, add_constraint, add_part, add_connector, add_mate, add_workspace_target, set_scene_return, solve_mates, flatten_pattern, evaluate_sdf, capture_animation, resolve_assumptions, run_fea, fea_summary, repair_script, sweep_tolerance, diff_geometry, drawing_to_cad, mesh_to_features, execute_cookbook, fab_pack, ray_pick, inspect_nurbs, fit_plane, mesh_boolean, explode_view, apply_surface_blend, write_bom, blockout_assembly, estimate_assembly_manufacturing, request_assembly_quote.

query.description: Keywords describing the capability you need (e.g. "assembly mate", "nurbs surface", "export stl").
